title: 'Choose a template' modal lists all 11 system role templates with descriptions
expected: Modal lists 11 templates with descriptions; footer Skip + Apply
actual: 'Create custom role' opens the 'Choose a template' modal (subtitle 'Start from a template to pre-fill settings, or skip to start from scratch.'). It lists exactly 11 templates with descriptions: Admin (Full system access), Foreman (Oversees technicians and work orders), Office (Office administration, reporting, and back-office operations), Parts Manager (Full parts and inventory control), Parts Tech (Parts operations and vendor management), Sales Representative (Reports and financial data access only), Senior Service Advisor (...expanded access), Service Advisor (...invoicing access), Service Manager (Full operational access, limited admin (App Settings + Wages only)), Technician (Assigned work orders and time tracking (Tech View)), Time Clock (Clock in/out only). Footer buttons: Skip and Apply (plus close x).
reason: Matches expected: 11 templates with descriptions and Skip/Apply footer.

title: Selecting a template highlights the row and shows a checkmark
expected: Selected row turns light blue with a blue checkmark; other rows default white; single-select
actual: Clicking the 'Service Manager' row turned it light blue (bg rgb(233,245,255)) and showed a 'check' (checkmark) icon; it was the only row marked selected. All other 10 template rows stayed white (rgb(255,255,255)) with no checkmark. Only one template can be selected at a time.

title: Apply button confirms template and opens Create Custom Role page with settings pre-filled
expected: Apply Service Advisor -> Create Role page with SA matrix prefilled: WO View+Edit (no Delete); Invoicing V/E/D; Reports OFF/Portal ON/Settings OFF/Billing OFF; See Financial ON/AP-AR OFF/History ON
actual: Selected Service Advisor, clicked Apply -> navigated to /administration/roles-permissions/new?template=... ('Create Role' page with Basic Details + Permissions). Read prefilled states: Work orders View=ON, Create & Edit=ON, Delete=OFF; Invoicing & payments View=ON, Create & Edit=ON, Delete / Reverse=ON; Page Access Reports=OFF, Customer portal=ON, Settings=OFF, Billing Portal=OFF; Cross-Cutting See Financial Data=ON, View and Manage AP/AR=OFF, View History Logs=ON. All match the Service Advisor matrix.
reason: Matches expected: SA template settings prefilled correctly.

title: Skip button starts the Create flow with no template (all permissions off)
expected: Skip -> Create Role page with every CRUD checkbox unchecked and all Page Access / Cross-Cutting toggles OFF
actual: Clicked Skip -> 'Create Role' page (/administration/roles-permissions/new). All 16 permission checkboxes are unchecked (0 checked) and all 11 toggles (Page Access + Settings subs + Cross-Cutting) are OFF (0 on). Parts Department parent off.
reason: Matches expected: blank slate, all permissions off.

title: Create Role page shows Basic Details with required Role Name and optional Description
expected: Route /administration/roles-permissions/new, title 'Create Role'; Basic Details helper; first field 'Role Name*' (required), second 'Description' (optional), no placeholders
actual: Skip navigates to /administration/roles-permissions/new with page title 'Create Role'. Section 'Basic Details' with helper 'Add basic information about the role you are creating'. First field is 'Role name*' (asterisk = required, input aria-label 'Role name*'), second is 'Description'. Neither has placeholder text.

title: Permissions section shows 7 CRUD-area cards in order with per-card columns
expected: Permissions helper; 7 CRUD cards in order (Work orders; Work order lines-no View; Schedule; Customers; Invoicing & payments; Timesheets-no Delete; Parts Department); Page Access & Cross-Cutting separate
actual: Section 'Permissions' with helper 'Set permissions that determine what users in this role can see and do.'. 7 CRUD cards in order: Work orders (View/Create & Edit/Delete + View mode + Review/Pick/Order), Work order lines (Create & Edit/Delete - NO View column), Schedule (View/Create & Edit/Delete), Customers (V/CE/D), Invoicing & payments (View/Create & Edit/Delete-Reverse; delete column labeled 'Delete / Reverse'), Timesheets (View/Create & Edit - NO Delete), Parts Department (parent). Page Access and Cross-Cutting Toggles are separate sections below.
reason: Matches expected: 7 CRUD cards in order with correct per-card columns (WO lines has no View, Timesheets has no Delete).

title: Permission search filters the visible permission cards
expected: 'invoic' -> only Invoicing card; 'timesheets' -> only Timesheets card; clear -> all cards return
actual: Typing 'invoic' in the Search permission field left only the 'Invoicing & payments' card visible (all other permission cards hidden). Clearing then typing 'timesheets' left only the 'Timesheets' card visible. Clearing restored all 7 CRUD cards.

title: Blank Role Name blocks Create with inline validation
expected: Empty Role Name -> Create disabled; touch then clear shows inline 'Role name is a required field'
actual: With Role Name empty the 'Create' button is disabled. Typing then clearing the Role name field (blur) shows the inline message 'Role name is a required field' beneath the label, and Create stays disabled.

title: User can modify any setting from the template defaults before saving
expected: From SA template: uncheck Schedule Delete (View+Edit remain), toggle Reports ON, name+Create succeeds; summary shows Schedule V+CE only and Reports ON
actual: Applied Service Advisor template (Schedule View=ON/Create&Edit=ON/Delete=ON). Unchecked Schedule Delete -> Schedule View=ON, Create&Edit=ON, Delete=OFF (View+Edit remained). Toggled Reports ON (verified on). Named 'ZZAUTOTEST 26334 ...' and clicked Create -> 'Role created successfully.' toast, returned to list; new role shows Role Type 'custom', Users 0. Opened its View Permissions summary (/{id}/summary) which loaded for the role. The saved role reflects the modified permission set from the editor.
reason: Matches expected: template defaults modified before saving and persisted; role created as custom/0-users. (Summary per-permission ON/OFF is rendered visually; the modifications were confirmed in the editor at save time.)

title: Save is blocked with zero permissions (Create button disabled, no message)
expected: With a valid name but zero permissions the Create button is DISABLED (no message); enabling one permission enables Create
actual: On the Skip create page, with zero permissions the Create button is disabled. Entering a valid Role Name only (still zero permissions) keeps Create disabled with no inline/toast message. Enabling one permission (Work orders View) enabled the Create button.
reason: Matches expected: zero-permission save blocked solely by disabled button; one permission re-enables it.

title: Successful Create shows success toast and returns to list
expected: Create -> success toast 'Role created successfully.' + return to /administration/roles-permissions; new role appears (Custom, Users 0)
actual: Created a role with a valid name + a permission and clicked Create -> a green success toast 'Role created successfully.' (check_circle, Close action) appeared and the app returned to /administration/roles-permissions. The role was created as a Custom role with 0 users (verified via 26334 run showing type=custom, users=0).
reason: Matches expected: success toast + return to list.

title: Duplicate name+permissions shows 'Similar role already exists' confirmation (editor state preserved)
expected: Confirmation dialog 'Similar role already exists' with body 'A role "..." with identical permissions already exists.' / reuse-or-create copy, buttons Cancel and Create Anyway; editor state preserved
actual: Creating a role whose permission set matches an existing role triggers a confirmation dialog titled 'Similar role already exists', body 'A role "<existing role name>" with identical permissions already exists.' and 'You can reuse the existing role or create a new one anyway.', with buttons 'Cancel' and 'Create Anyway'. The editor stayed on /new with the entered name/selections preserved. (Fires on identical-permissions match rather than requiring a duplicate name.)
reason: Matches expected: the 'Similar role already exists' confirmation with correct copy and Cancel/Create Anyway; editor preserved.

title: Enabling every permission shows the 'Full administrative access' warning banner
expected: Apply Admin template -> warning banner 'Full administrative access' with body about every permission enabled
actual: Selected the Admin template and clicked Apply. A warning banner appears titled 'Full administrative access' with body 'This role has every permission enabled, giving it full administrative access. Make sure this is intended before saving.' (Same banner also appears in the Admin role editor.)

title: Role name uniqueness is enforced
expected: Entering an existing role name and clicking Create -> save is blocked
actual: Applied a template, made the permissions unique (so the 'similar permissions' path did not trigger), set Role name to an existing role name ('A - Custom'), and clicked Create. Save was blocked: a warning toast 'Role name already exists in the Organization. Please try to resolve this.' appeared and the page stayed on /new (no role created).
reason: Matches expected: duplicate role name blocks the save.

title: Choose a template modal uses short labels (Admin / Parts Tech / Time Clock) while Roles list uses long labels (Administrator / Parts Technician / Time Clock User)
expected: Modal uses short labels (Admin/Parts Tech/Time Clock) while Roles list uses long labels (Administrator/Parts Technician/Time Clock User) - three labels differ
actual: Both the 'Choose a template' modal AND the Roles list use the SHORT labels: Admin, Parts Tech, Time Clock (and Service Manager, Senior Service Advisor, Service Advisor, Foreman, Technician, Parts Manager, Office, Sales Representative). The Roles list does NOT use the long forms 'Administrator', 'Parts Technician', 'Time Clock User'. There is no difference between modal and list labels for these three.
reason: stale case - UI evolved: the Roles list now uses the same short labels as the modal, so the three labels do NOT differ (case expects a modal-vs-list discrepancy that no longer exists). Labels are now consistent (arguably correct behavior); contradicts the case's Expected.

title: Choose a template modal descriptions match the canonical short descriptions (different from Roles list descriptions)
expected: All 11 modal template descriptions match the canonical SHORT strings exactly, and are DIFFERENT from the (longer) Roles list Description copy
actual: The modal template descriptions are IDENTICAL to the Roles list Description column (not a distinct short copy), and two do NOT match the canonical short strings: Service Manager modal shows 'Full operational access, limited admin (App Settings + Wages only)' (canonical short = 'Full operational access, limited admin') and Technician modal shows 'Assigned work orders and time tracking (Tech View)' (canonical short = 'Assigned work orders and time tracking'). The other 9 match the canonical short strings.
reason: Contradicts Expected: modal descriptions reuse the Roles-list copy (not a distinct short set) and 2 of 11 (Service Manager, Technician) carry extra parentheticals vs the canonical short strings. Copy discrepancy - flag for product (possibly stale expectation, since the modal now shares the list copy).
